Folks — forwarding ClearPeak’s note. They want a single MAP doc that stitches success criteria + non-functional exit gates + a runnable acceptance-test checklist for a 2-week eval. Procurement insists on seeing it before SOW.

Key constraints:
- They will run a 2-week evaluation with a perf run at the end (target concurrency ~120 reqs/min; median payload ~512 tokens).
- Security evidence must include SOC 2 summary + list of recent pentest findings and mitigations, or a note about time-to-fix blocking items.
- They explicitly want KV cache and data retention behavior spelled out (hosted vs private).

I drafted a short MAP (attached) focused on these gates — perf thresholds, functional smoke, security checklist, rollback criteria, and decision owners. Please review and add any gaps. I’ll send to Alex once we align.

Proposed acceptance gates (top-level):
1) Functional: end-to-end inference accuracy smoke (sample prompts pass >95% of golden set).
2) Performance: p95 latency < 250ms for 512-token median payload under the specified concurrency in a 30-minute sustained window.
3) Reliability: no more than 1% error rate for token generation during the perf run.
4) Security: SOC 2 evidence on file + no outstanding critical pentest items.
5) Data handling: documented retention and an explicit statement about ephemeral KV cache behavior for hosted mode.

I added owners in the spreadsheet (Maya = program owner; Karthik = SOW/procurement liaison; Ben = infra/serving runbook).

Subject: ClearPeak MAP + acceptance checklist (map_v3 attached)

Alex — attaching the MAP we discussed. High-level summary below; full test steps and pass/fail criteria are in the spreadsheet (ClearPeak_MAP_v3.xlsx) and the perf harness repo link.

Summary of acceptance gates and required evidence:
- Functional smoke: 20 golden prompts. Pass condition: >=95% of responses match acceptance labels (manual review + automated heuristics). Owner: ClearPeak + Redwood Solutions.
- Performance: 30-minute sustained run at 120 reqs/min, median payload 512 tokens. Pass condition: p95 latency < 250ms and error rate <=1%. Owner: Redwood Infra; witness by ClearPeak.
- Reliability: No sustained token-level degradation; KV cache warming allowed but must be documented. If burst nodes are required, we note it in the SOW appendix.
- Security: SOC 2 report (summary) attached; pentest findings document attached. Pass condition: no outstanding critical severity items. Any high-severity items must have documented mitigations and an agreed timeline. Owner: Redwood Security.
- Data handling: Written statement included that hosted-mode KV cache entries are ephemeral and purged within 24 hours; private deployment retains no customer KV beyond session unless explicitly configured.

Exit gates (explicit):
- Go: All gates pass, procurement signs pilot SOW; plan to start pilot cutover within 5 business days.
- Hold: Any security critical or performance failure — pilot delayed until remediation and re-test.
- Rollback: If during pilot the error rate exceeds 5% or data-handling evidence is inconsistent, auto-fallback to isolated capacity and joint incident review within 4 hours.

Attachments: ClearPeak_MAP_v3.xlsx, RWI_SLA_draft_2026.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf, pentest_findings_redacted.pdf

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben to confirm infra schedule and whether hosted burst pool meets perf target (reply by Mon EOD).
2) Karthik to share SOW appendix referencing the MAP (Mon EOD).
3) If both align, schedule perf run Wed 29th (two-hour window + 30-minute ramp; final analysis same day).

If that works, we’ll prepare a short sign-off checklist for procurement to sign once the perf run results are shared.

Thanks —
